contact.basis: Public sidewalk in front of the entrance canopy.

verticalDatum: AHN4 NAP meters, EPSG:28992 horizontal grid
attribution: Actueel Hoogtebestand Nederland AHN4 via PDOK; CC0
method: Bilinear sampling of original AHN4 0.5 m DTM pixel centers into the signed 2 m local grid. Valid source heights are unchanged. Missing source cells beneath buildings/objects use nearest valid sample in each of eight angular sectors, inverse-distance-squared weighted. No model-height fitting or flattening.
limitations: AHN4 DTM masks buildings; interpolated ground beneath the building is an estimate, not a measured floor or survey surface.
Review grid spacing is 2 m; valid source data is 0.5 m. Small steps and cellar lightwells are generalized.
